name: supervisor-dev
description: The marketplace of Supervisor for Claude Code: add it with `claude plugin marketplace add frsorrentino/supervisor`, then `claude plugin install supervisor@supervisor-dev`.

plugins.name: supervisor
plugins.description: Supervisor for Claude Code. Run many Claude Code sessions on one machine: launch them in the right folder and account, in tmux, with a terminal window whose tab tells you which is which; list, close, restart, talk to them and restore them after a reboot. Configurable per machine, generic across terminals.
